services.name: reader
services.description: Read any web page as clean text or markdown (Jina Reader)

routes.description: Read a web page. JSON body {"url": "https://..."}; returns title, description and content as markdown

services.name: wikipedia
services.description: English Wikipedia: article summaries and search

routes.description: Summary of a Wikipedia article by title, e.g. /api/rest_v1/page/summary/Lisbon

Forecast for coordinates: ?latitude=38.72&longitude=-9.14&current=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m&daily=temperature_2m_max,precipitation_sum&timezone=auto (Lisbon is 38.72,-9.14; London 51.51,-0.13; New York 40.71,-74.01)

services.name: fx
services.description: Currency exchange rates from the European Central Bank (Frankfurter)

services.name: search
services.description: Web search built for agents: ranked results with content snippets and an optional answer (Tavily)

routes.description: Search the web. JSON body {"query": "...", "max_results": 5}; returns results with url, title, content and score
Translate text. JSON body {"text": ["Hello, world"], "target_lang": "JA"}; returns translations with the detected source language

services.name: speech
services.description: Speech to text for audio up to a few minutes (Deepgram)

routes.description: Transcribe audio. Send the file as the body with its content type (audio/wav, audio/mpeg, ...) or JSON {"url": "https://..."}; query ?model=nova-3&smart_format=true
